http: http covers the exact bytes a host serves and a browser checks with Subresource Integrity: text artifacts are served with LF line endings, binary artifacts byte for byte. A client compares bytes it fetched over HTTP only with http, never with the normalized sha256.
normalization: Hashes cover the content as stored in git: in text artifacts CRLF line endings count as LF, binary artifacts (.wasm) are hashed byte for byte.
